If you’re looking for a high\-profile, challenging opportunity supporting the U.S. Navy, Serco has an exciting opportunity for you. This position will join a dynamic team supporting Team Submarine. Bring your expertise, technical skills, and collaborative approach to a mission\-critical role that helps advance U.S. national security and the safety and effectiveness of our Sailors.

Program Executive Office Submarines, Program Manager for the Virginia\-Class Submarine (PMS 450\), is responsible for the acquisition of the U.S. Navy’s Virginia\-Class nuclear\-powered attack submarines. PMS 450 identifies, assembles, manages, directs, and coordinates the resources required for research and development, design, construction, Test and Evaluation (T\&E), Live Fire Test and Evaluation (LFT\&E), and fleet introduction.


PMS 450 is responsible for developing and deploying an affordable, nuclear\-powered attack submarine with multi\-mission capabilities and enhanced performance in littoral environments. Virginia\-Class submarines support five of the Navy’s six core maritime capabilities: Deterrence, Maritime Security, Sea Control, Forward Presence, and Power Projection.

jobs.description:
The **Implementation Specialist** is responsible for leading the successful onboarding and implementation of new and existing clients onto the Serve You Rx PBM platform. This role functions as the primary project manager during the implementation phase, ensuring accurate configuration, on\-time delivery, and a seamless transition to ongoing client support within the Client Success team.

  


**What You’ll Do:**

  


As the **Implementation Specialist**, you will:


* Lead end\-to\-end PBM implementations, including benefit configuration, eligibility setup, formulary alignment, and testing
* Serve as the primary project manager for assigned client implementations, managing timelines, milestones, and deliverables
* Act as the main point of contact for clients throughout the implementation process
* Partner closely with internal teams (Clinical, IT, Operations, Pharmacy, and Finance) to ensure accurate system setup
* Coordinate data exchanges such as eligibility files, accumulators, reporting requirements, and other client data needs
* Manage client communication strategies throughout implementation, including planning and execution of member disruption mitigation and notification efforts
* Request, review, and track appropriate use of historical claims files, prior authorization (PA) files, and ORFT data to support accurate implementation and transition activities
* Confirm member lettering requirements and facilitate required member communications in alignment with client expectations, regulatory standards, and PBM guidelines
* Proactively identify risks, resolve issues, and escalate concerns as appropriate
* Facilitate implementation meetings, status calls, and post\-implementation handoffs to account management
* Ensure all implementations meet PBM regulatory requirements and Serve You Rx standards
* Maintain clear documentation of client configurations, communication plans, and implementation workflows
* Contribute to process improvements and best practices within the Client Success department

  




**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field OR minimum of 5 years of PBM, TPA project management experience
* Preferably experience within a PBM, managed care, or pharmacy operations environment
* Demonstrated project management experience, including managing multiple concurrent implementations
* Strong knowledge of PBM and TPA operations, pharmacy benefits, claims processing, and eligibility management
* Excellent communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
* Prior PBM implementation or client onboarding experience preferred
* Project management certification (PMP, CAPM, or similar) preferred
* Experience working with employer groups, TPAs, brokers, or health plans preferred
* Familiarity with pharmacy benefit systems and data integrations preferred
* Deep knowledge of PBM operations and pharmacy benefit processes.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Strong organizational skills with ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
* Proficiency in MS Office/Outlook and ability to learn internal systems quickly.
* Ability to perform in a fast\-paced environment, respond under pressure, and handle escalations professionally.

  


**Why Serve You Rx?**

  


Serve You Rx is a full\-service pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) with unquestionable flexibility and an unwavering commitment to doing what's best for its clients. With a fervent focus on those it serves, including insurance brokers, consultants, third\-party administrators, and their clients, Serve You Rx delivers exceptional service and tailored, cost\-effective benefit solutions. Independent and privately held for nearly 40 years, Serve You Rx can implement new groups in 30 days or less and say "yes" to a wide variety of viable solutions. Known for its adaptability, quality, and client\-centricity, Serve You Rx aims to be a benchmark for better client service.

  


The company offers generous benefits to include: medical (HMO and PPO), dental, vision, 401k, HSA, identity theft and legal coverage, pet insurance, paid parental leave, and 18 days of paid time off in your first year.

Birdeye is the leading agentic marketing platform for multi\-location brands.


Companies like H\&R Block, Aspen Dental, and Caesars Entertainment use Birdeye to manage marketing across thousands of locations — from how they get found, to how they convert, to how they retain customers. We are looking for a customer\-focused Implementation Specialist to own the end\-to\-end deployment of Birdeye's AI and voice solutions. This role will work closely with customers, IT teams, FDEs, Product, and Engineering to configure, test, and launch solutions successfully.

NAIS is seeking a senior Technical Application Subject Matter Expert to support the sustainment, integration, and continued development of mission\-critical federal health information systems.


The Technical Application SME will provide senior technical leadership across application development, systems analysis, database technologies, data architecture, data warehousing, testing, networking, integration, and production support. The position will work closely with functional SMEs, government stakeholders, cybersecurity personnel, and multidisciplinary engineering teams.


This position is designated as Key Personnel. Employment is contingent upon contract award, customer approval, and successful completion of applicable security, suitability, and onboarding requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide senior technical guidance for the sustainment and enhancement of enterprise health applications.

* Support requirements analysis, system design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and production\-readiness activities.

* Develop and maintain technical documentation, architectural materials, interface specifications, data documentation, operating procedures, and decision records.

The position may require collaboration with geographically distributed government, military, clinical, cybersecurity, and engineering stakeholders. Occasional travel may be required based on final program needs.
